ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by approximately 85% low-intensity black pixels and 15% high-intensity white pixels concentrated at the distal extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-intensity region spanning the central and medial fluke surface. High-intensity white contiguous patch on the distal 20% of the right lobe. Fragmented white mottling on the distal 10% of the left lobe. Randomly distributed high-intensity punctate spots across the medial dark region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a symmetrical inward taper toward the fluke base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency serrations across both lobes. Visible irregular pixel-amplitude peaks on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe and subtle jagged variations along the mid-section of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Linear trajectory along the medial lobes transitioning to a slight distal convexity near the lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) scattered across the dark-pigmented medial surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, high-relief, textured yellowish-white pixel clusters on the extreme distal tips of both lobes, representing significant biological colonization or structural deformity.
